analysis:
All changed files are advisory CI tooling under .github/scripts. They do not touch provider code, the coordinator WebSocket, App Attest, key custody or any canonical TB-002/TB-011 control. No threat-model asset or boundary is affected.

threat-model-review.py (head lines 16-31, 40-41): runtime_seconds reads THREAT_REVIEW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS from the workflow environment, defaults to 900 and enforces 60..3000. The alarm is now armed inside the try block, so an invalid value goes to the generic setup-failure handler, which writes diagnostics and does not leak the value. The setup-failure message now says human review is required and not to rerun the paid scan. The 3000s alarm sits under the 60-minute job timeout the tests expect, so there is time to publish partial results.

bedrock.py (head lines ~46-84, 133, 234): a new BEDROCK_SCAN_CALL_POLICY of fixed or workload. Any other value is rejected. In workload mode the ceiling comes from BEDROCK_SCAN_MAX_WORKLOAD_CALLS (1..500) and the limit starts at 0. plan_calls raises BudgetStopped if planned calls plus one repair slot exceed the ceiling, and it sets the sticky workload_stopped flag, which `stopped` reads. This fails closed. Calls made before any planning are blocked by the existing `calls >= limit` check. Higher output tokens (16384) and a 600s read timeout raise worst-case paid cost but remain bounded by the ceiling. The existing usage ledger and accounting-stop behavior are unchanged, and the new metrics expose policy, limit, ceiling and planned calls without secrets.

The tests (test-threat-model-review.py) assert workflow properties: no workflow_dispatch in the review job, no pr_number or review_depth inputs, base SHA taken only from the PR event, and hash-pinned pip installs. This tightens the trust boundary. The workflow YAML and the budget_runner caller of plan_calls are not in this batch, so I could not confirm that the real workflow matches these assertions or that plan_calls is invoked before every stage. The next pass should confirm this. No security regression was found in the supplied evidence.
